name: C. H. Skelton
mentions: C. H. Skelton, representing Strong, Hackett & Co., of St. Paul, has been here a day or two replenishing the hardware stocks of our merchants.
…and wife, Mt. Pleasant, Iowa; S. Riddle, Waverly, Neb.; J. L. Truscott and wife, Medora; J. J. Graham, C. H. Skilton, St. Paul.
